items.stem: Fertiliser running off farmland causes algal blooms and low-oxygen 'dead zones' in a lake. Which cycle is most directly disrupted? (Select ONE)

options.rationale: Correct: excess nitrogen and phosphorus drive eutrophication.
The rock cycle is not the main driver of algal blooms.
That is unrelated to nutrient pollution.

options.text: The cycle of the Moon's phases
options.rationale: Lunar phases do not cause algal blooms.

items.explanation: Correct: excess nitrogen and phosphorus drive eutrophication.

items.stem: Select TWO genuine trade-offs or limits of renewable energy sources. (Select TWO)

options.text: Some sources are intermittent and depend on weather or time of day
options.rationale: Correct: solar and wind vary with conditions, needing storage or backup.

options.text: Building the infrastructure still has material and land-use impacts
options.rationale: Correct: manufacture and siting carry real environmental costs.

options.text: They release more carbon dioxide in use than coal does
options.rationale: Renewables generally emit far less carbon in use than coal.

options.text: They can never generate any usable electricity
options.rationale: Renewables do generate substantial usable electricity.

items.explanation: Correct: solar and wind vary with conditions, needing storage or backup.
